{
  "meta": {
    "title": "Token Bucket in a Shared Store",
    "topicClass": "concept",
    "format": "full",
    "targetLengthSec": 65
  },
  "story": {
    "devices": [
      "real_incident",
      "planted_question",
      "object_to_data",
      "versus_split",
      "failure_before_fix",
      "what_breaks",
      "contrast_takeaway"
    ],
    "runningExample": "A customer checks out at an online shop; each checkout attempt spends one token, and all gateway instances share one count for that customer.",
    "chapters": [
      {
        "id": "ch-outage",
        "title": "The outage"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch-token",
        "title": "Shared token bucket"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch-slow",
        "title": "When the store slows"
      }
    ],
    "beats": [
      {
        "id": "b1",
        "chapterId": "ch-outage",
        "intent": "A slow limiter store failed 31% of checkouts for 47 minutes, and plant the question of why a store can do that.",
        "device": "real_incident",
        "targetSec": 8,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-19"
        ],
        "hookNumberIds": [
          "num-18",
          "num-19"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "centered_focus",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": [],
        "source": "Larkspur Pay platform team, 14 March 2025"
      },
      {
        "id": "b2",
        "chapterId": "ch-token",
        "intent": "A customer's checkout request spends one token from a bucket that refills at 10 per second and caps at 100, so bursts stay bounded.",
        "device": "object_to_data",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-1",
          "fact-2",
          "num-1",
          "num-2"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "cycle",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": [
          "token bucket"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "b3",
        "chapterId": "ch-token",
        "intent": "Per-instance buckets would give a caller spread across 24 nodes 24 times its limit, so the bucket moves into one shared store.",
        "device": "versus_split",
        "targetSec": 9,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-7",
          "num-3"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "versus_split",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "versus_split"
        ],
        "newTerms": [
          "shared store"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "b4",
        "chapterId": "ch-token",
        "intent": "Two gateway nodes race to spend the last token; the atomic script inside the store lets only one spend it, and the other sees 429.",
        "device": "failure_before_fix",
        "targetSec": 9,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-6",
          "num-26"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "hub_spoke",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "atomic_lock"
        ],
        "newTerms": [
          "atomic script"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "b5",
        "chapterId": "ch-slow",
        "intent": "The shared store adds 0.4 ms per request; calls past 50 ms count as failed, and that flips the limiter's failure policy.",
        "device": "what_breaks",
        "targetSec": 9,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-8",
          "fact-14",
          "num-4",
          "num-16"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "pipeline",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": []
      },
      {
        "id": "b6",
        "chapterId": "ch-slow",
        "intent": "After failover the store reached 80 ms; fail open made every instance enforce the full limit and downstream got 40 times the contracted rate.",
        "device": "real_incident",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-20",
          "fact-21",
          "fact-22",
          "num-21",
          "num-23"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": false,
        "layoutMode": "versus_split",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "versus_split"
        ],
        "newTerms": [],
        "source": "Larkspur Pay platform team, 14 March 2025"
      },
      {
        "id": "b7",
        "chapterId": "ch-slow",
        "intent": "Checkout now fails closed, divides fallback limits by instance count, and raises the store timeout to 150 ms.",
        "device": "contrast_takeaway",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-23",
          "num-25"
        ],
        "continuesPrevious": true,
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": []
      }
    ],
    "plantedQuestion": {
      "text": "Why did a slow limiter store fail 31% of checkouts for 47 minutes?",
      "beatId": "b1",
      "payoffBeatId": "b6"
    },
    "rejectedAlternative": {
      "beatId": "b3",
      "summary": "Each gateway node keeping its own bucket would give a caller spread across 24 nodes 24 times its limit, so the bucket moves into one shared store.",
      "chosenBeatId": "b4"
    },
    "ending": {
      "kind": "spec_card_ending",
      "cta": "Share this with a teammate who thinks per-instance buckets are fine.",
      "specCard": {
        "lines": [
          "Shared bucket per key",
          "Atomic read-refill-write",
          "Fail closed when store slow"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
